notes.note: Speaker labels in this event run one row late (cf. story_128 #0.97 labelled Ankh but clearly Gaddess). This row is Gaddess ordering Epyon to chase the fleeing party; 'saseru mono ka' = 'I won't let you'.
Read as Deathscythe Hell (label on next row) blocking Epyon/Gaddess so the party can run; Duo's wisecracking voice.
#0.1-15: 15 party-leader copies, all identical JP -> identical EN. 'Ushiro' rendered 'Behind us' (Epyon catches up from behind).
Silent row, most likely Epyon (label on #0.18).
Single non-variant line; speaker not recovered (rough 'yagatta', possibly Ankh or a fixed companion). Subject restored as 'he' = Epyon (glossary g=m, Zechs).
#0.35-49: 15-row leader scream block (labels Ankh/Epyon/?party look shifted, not real speakers). Each distinct JP cry rendered distinctly; #0.49 identical JP to #0.35 -> identical EN.
#0.51-65: 15 identical leader copies. 'Zero System' as used in earlier slices (not in glossary terms).
Wing Zero (Heero) arriving and answering the question above: 'chigau na' = 'No, it isn't' (story_130 has him explain Epyon is being swallowed by the Zero System). Speaker inferred from story_130.
#0.71-82 leader block continues into story_130 (#0.83-84); 14 variants since Wing Zero is the one arriving. 'Naze koko ni!!' rendered as a shouted question with '!?'.
Only differing variant: 'omae, ittai!!' = cut-off 'you, just what...'; kept trailing.

report: 80/80 rows. Speaker labels run one row late in this event; speakers inferred from neighbours. Uncertain: #0.119 Gaddess / #0.120 Deathscythe Hell (from shifted labels); #0.33 speaker not recovered ('he' = Epyon); #0.70 assumed Wing Zero. Not in glossary: Zero System (used in earlier slices).
